method: Independently downloaded fresh official GitHub codeload tar.gz archives at the exact documented commit. Compared SHA-256 of every currently vendored file (including manifests and licenses) against its exact archive path, without extracting or executing archive contents. No source or license file was modified.
scope: All regular files and symlinks currently under lib/, plus the four copied API3 helper/license files. Upstream files deliberately omitted from the vendored subsets are outside this comparison.
plainVendorRevisionWarningExplanation: These are plain vendored source directories with no individual .git metadata. git invoked from a library directory resolves the enclosing Second Order project repository and its HEAD, not the upstream dependency revision. Foundry revision-discovery warnings comparing that parent HEAD to foundry.lock therefore do not independently demonstrate dependency drift. The exact file-by-file comparisons below establish whether the vendored subset matches each pinned upstream archive. All matches mean no observed file drift in the compared subset; this is provenance verification, not a security audit.
